title: Aerial Survey and Mapping Services
content: Soaring Aerotech provides B2B aerial survey and mapping with centimeter-level accuracy (±2cm). We deliver high-precision 3D terrain models, orthomosaics, and GIS outputs for highways, land records, and mining projects.

title: Solar Plant Thermal Inspections
content: Professional solar farm thermographic inspections. Using advanced thermal sensors, we identify hotspot anomalies and bypass diode failures (450+ faults detected) with zero grid downtime.

title: Precision Agriculture and Crop Spraying
content: Precision agricultural spraying using heavy multirotors. We provide multispectral crop health analysis (NDVI mapping) and targeted pesticide/fertilizer spraying, saving time and resources.

title: Infrastructure and Power Substation Inspection
content: UAV inspection for power grids, wind turbines, chimneys, and bridges. Operations are carried out with zero shutdown required, identifying structural defects 5x faster than manual inspections.

title: Custom UAV Hardware and AI Solutions
content: Custom drone manufacturing and AI solutions. We develop purpose-built hardware payloads, custom flight controllers, and computer vision AI models for autonomous surveillance and security patrols.
